about: ARKBOARD Process: definitions and methods for every metric and model, plus FV conversion charts per board.

entries.short: Grade on the 20-80 scale of what a prospect becomes at peak: the mean outcome of past players with that profile.
body: 50 average regular, 60 plus, 70 star, 80 generational. Tiers every 5 points, grades in steps of 1.
Each board has its own outcome and rarity ladder. There is no shared cross-sport FV scale.
Headline = mean of the tier odds (busts and stars included), so it sits below the best case.
Graded on absolute talent from a fixed map fit on pooled history, not on rank within a class or board.
Strong classes get more high grades. Age and validated drivers adjust the grade.
entries.where: Every prospect board: CFB, CBB, hockey prospects, soccer prospects, tennis prospects; recruit tabs; MLB boards

entries.short: The realized outcome each FV tier stands for, set by rarity on each board.
body: CFB: NFL career (All-Pro, Pro Bowl, seasons as a starter), 2012-18 drafts.
CBB: peak NBA XPM, as rare as the matching NBA role (7+ All-NBA = 80), careers ending 2008-16.
Hockey: peak NHL pWAR (best 3 of first 7 seasons), rarity in a draft class, 2008-19 classes.
Soccer: peak GAR at ages 22-26, rarity in a birth year and position group, players 22 in 2013-21.
Tennis: peak ranking points above No. 200 at ages 22-28, rarity in a birth year per tour, births 1979-97.
Tennis ATP fit also trains on births after 1997, partial careers imputed to a final outcome.
entries.where: fv model tab on each prospect page; FV conversion charts below

entries.short: Above each board's knot K the headline runs linear to 80 at T, so an 80 comes about once every 5 seasons.
body: Mean of a capped outcome cannot reach 80; the stretch makes 80 reachable but rare (Oct 31 2026).
K = mean that about 3 players a season reach; T = one player per about 5 seasons (exponential tail, held out).
Order is unchanged. The exact mean (fvx) stays in tooltips; above K the headline reads hotter than realized means.
entries.where: Headline FV on every prospect board (data/fv_scale.json)

entries.short: Each player's odds of every outcome tier and their 10th-90th percentile outcome.
body: CFB and CBB: location-scale ordered probit of realized outcome on the grade; cut points at 30, 35 ... 70.
Spread terms kept only if held-out RPS improves (CFB: early season x2.1, walk-on, consensus, underclassman).
Held out: CFB RPS .0398 vs .0408 one spread; CBB .0767. Hockey, soccer, tennis: logistic odds per tier.
Shown in the player dropdown only; main boards show the single headline.

entries.term: Tier chances (NBA%, NHL%, Top%, Reg%, Star%)
entries.short: Chance of reaching a set outcome tier.
body: CBB NBA% = P(plays in the NBA), first rung of the FV model.
Hockey NHL% = 40+ (top 45 of a class); Reg% = 50+ (NHL regular, top 20 of a class).
Soccer Top% = 40+ (top-flight regular, top 250 of a birth year at position); Reg% = 50+ (top 90); Star% = 60+ (top 20).
entries.where: Board columns: CBB, hockey prospects, soccer prospects

entries.short: A + marks a player whose star odds beat the next 2.5 FV, from age.
body: Rule: + when P(60+ | FV, age) >= P(60+ | FV + 2.5). Only age passed held out as an upside signal.
Soccer held out t 5.0 / 4.1 at 55+ / 60+; tennis ATP t 4.3 / 3.3, WTA 3.9 / 3.1. Shares: tennis ~6%, soccer ~30% of top 2000.
CFB + rule failed held out (t -.71 / -.34) and was removed. CBB and hockey signals: none pass.
entries.where: Soccer prospects and tennis prospects boards

entries.short: A birth-year-only player gets the mean birth day for his class, not Oct 15.
body: k = first D-I season - birth year - (class - 1).
Mean day of year by k from 16,744 day-precise careers: k 19 Apr 30, k 20 Jul 24, k 21+ Aug 22.
Held out on 942 board players who entered 2023 or later:
mean absolute age error .347 yr (Oct 15) and .258 (Jul 1) -> .237 (t 15.6 and 5.8).
FIBA youth rosters on file add a day-precise date when the birth year agrees with Barttorvik's:
1,401 of 1,427 checked dates within 3 days.

entries.short: A grade for a player off the source board: starts at the 20 floor and takes every available driver.
body: Ranked in FV order with a prov tag. CBB: ridge on height, weight, class, age, recruit rank, team top-8 FV (R2 .77).
Hockey: OHL, WHL, QMJHL, AHL and Liiga draft-eligibles off Tankathon, graded on NHLe, age, weight, position.
Soccer: academy-only and youth-international players get their own provisional line.
CFB: ESPN roster backups and carried-over players graded from the 20 floor.

entries.short: Held-out check of each board: graded FV band vs what the players became.
body: Per band: mean FV given vs reached (90% CI), predicted 40+/50+/60+ odds vs realized share.
Slopes: CFB .99, CBB .97, soccer 1.01, tennis ATP .99 / WTA .97; hockey calibrated.
Known heat: WTA 45-64 runs 2.5-4.8 hot; CFB 40+ odds 6-8 pts hot at FV 40-49.
entries.where: fv model tab, fv scorecard window

entries.short: An input enters an FV model only if it cuts held-out error.
body: Hockey, soccer, tennis: t >= 2 across held-out classes/seasons/birth years and wins two thirds of them.
CBB: dropping the driver must raise out-of-sample deviance in 4 of 5 folds (whole players held out).
CFB: multipliers refit leaving one draft class out; kept only if within-position r with NFL AV improves.
entries.where: fv model tabs (drivers kept, out-of-sample evidence)

entries.short: NFL outcome grade for every FBS and FCS player.
body: Composite: production (Stat+, Marcel 5/4/3, regressed), On3 talent, age, frame, combine, badges, XV parts.
Composite rank per class maps to FV by measured NFL outcome counts per position (drafts 2012-18).
Scouting consensus (9 boards + Kiper top 25) blended at weight .5 at full coverage.
Then the outcome step (ordered probit), mean headline, stretched top. Positional value scales elite RB, LB, DL, TE, S.
entries.where: CFB board, draft board, fv model tab

entries.short: NBA outcome grade for every D-I player and listed internationals.
body: E[FV] = 20 + 10 P(30+) + 10 P(40+) + 10 P(50+) + (mean 60+ career - 50) P(60+); one ridge logistic per rung.
Newcomers: recruit rank (On3, 247, Barttorvik), class. Returners: 3-season BPM, conference power, age, size, rates.
Board stage adds June draft-board rank and guard combine testing. E maps to a grade on pooled 2009-16 boards.
Outcome odds are fit on each board's top 300; below that range they scale down to the floor those boards realized (1.8% NBA).
In season: E = (1 - w) preseason + w now, w = minutes / (minutes + k); k 85 newcomers, 156 returners.
entries.where: CBB board, fv model tab, in season window

entries.short: OLS on outcome FV for the draft class and drafted players short of 100 NHL games.
body: Draft model kept: log slot (board rank as slot), defense, goalie, draft-year NHLe, class strength.
Leave-one-class-out error 87.11 vs 91.63 for slot alone (2008-19 classes, 2,541 picks).
After the draft: stage models add latest NHLe, pro games, World Juniors spot, NHL games and WAR so far.
entries.where: Hockey prospects board, drafted prospects, fv model tab

entries.short: OLS on outcome FV for every under-22 in 33 leagues plus academy and feeder leagues.
body: Inputs kept include age, market value (deflated to the fit seasons' level), GAR this and last season,
minutes share, club strength, scoring rate, height, position, PL2 minutes. 53,682 rows, 2013-20.
Detailed position block (centre-back, full-back, defensive / attacking midfield, winger, striker vs central
midfield): season-out error -0.10, t 3.9, 7 of 8 seasons, top 50 and forward test better.
Raw grade = mean of the OLS grade and a gradient-boosted grade (300 trees of depth 3 on every design input,
one set per snapshot): season-out error 55.62 -> 54.62, t 8.7, 8 of 8 seasons. The trees get no missing-height
signal and market values only as dated on a player's own lineups.
Held out by birth cohort: error 54.84 vs 64.42 for age and market value alone (R2 .43).
entries.where: Soccer prospects board, fv model tab

entries.short: Hurdle model for every ATP and WTA player under 22 with a ranking or a pro match in the last year.
body: Logistic for any peak value, OLS on outcome FV given value: FV = (1 - p) x 20 + p x mean given value.
ATP kept: age, rank, unranked, Elo, 52-week win rate, years since pro debut, Futures volume.
WTA kept: age, rank, unranked, Elo, rank x age, tour-qualifying volume. Held out by birth year; OOS R2 .50 / .46.
Height is never an input (the archive fills height for players who made it: a leak).
ATP fit also trains on unfinished careers (later births at imputed targets): as-of 2011-18 error 21.45 -> 20.24, t 7.8, 8 of 8.

ATP tree blend (mean with a boosted-tree grade): as-of 20.24 -> 19.86, t 2.7, 7 of 8, p .015; a second form after the first failed, so it counts in the sweep's Holm family of 15 and misses (needs p <= .005): not used. WTA trees failed forward.
entries.where: Tennis prospects ATP and WTA boards, fv model tab

entries.short: Projected RWA over the next year against tier-1 starters, 20-80 (50 = average tier-1 starter).
body: Prospect = under 20 maps at S-tier events. Projection: rating, age, share of last year's rounds at S/A-tier events.
S/A share is negative on top of the rating's tier lift (held t -4.9). Rise and every stat line failed.
Quarterly cutoffs, fit 2024-25, held out from Jul 2025; a term ships only past the Bonferroni cut of its batch.
Badges (top 25% on a stat) tested on prospects and the main board: none passed, so CS2 shows none.

entries.short: Baseball boards are graded by hand on the FanGraphs 20-80 tiers.
body: No model. Tiers: 80 top 5 overall (7+ WAR a season), 60 All-Star (3.4-4.9), 50 average regular (1.6-2.4).
Boards: 2026 draft hitters v1 (May 7), U19 MiLB prospects, White Sox org top 64.
entries.where: Baseball page (draft hitters, U19 MiLB, White Sox org, fv scale)

entries.short: Projected FV for high school recruits.
body: CFB xFV = P(on board) x FV if on + (1 - P(on)) x 20, year 1; hurdle fit on ESPN 2023-26 classes.
CFB recruit profile weighed on NFL outcomes of 2011-19 classes; the board sets the level.
CBB: hurdle on consensus rank and old-for-class; P(reach NBA) then log(FV - 20) given NBA; trained 2009-16.
entries.where: Recruits tabs: 2027-2029 classes, class rankings, recruit model

entries.short: Recruit star rating cut from the projected FV, not the industry stars.
body: CFB: 5-star+ top 6 a class, 5 top 3% of board FV, 4 top 10%, 3 above median, 2 on board, 1 off board (year-3 xFV).
CBB: 5 = 2+ NBA seasons as a starter, 4 = reached the NBA, 3 = D-I starter at BPM +3, 2 = played D-I, 1 = did not.
Arrow = ARK stars minus industry stars.

entries.short: Bronze to platinum trait medals by the name: one stat each, regressed by volume.
body: Tiers at the 75/90/97/99th percentile of the position. CFB badges build archetypes.
On other boards a badge shows only if it predicts the sport's own outcome held out beyond the value metric.
Display only: no badge feeds FV or projections. Volume and usage traits pass; efficiency rates mostly fail.
entries.where: Every board (medals by the name), player cards

entries.short: Each player's grade at their best season, listed by position.
body: CFB rebuilds every FBS season 2014-25; box-score era (2014-18) means recalibrated to NFL outcomes.
CFB outcome: NFL AV a season since the draft over a class horizon index h (mean 1 on 2020-23 drafts), so old classes' out-of-league years don't count against them.
Other boards read their past lists; only grade-complete rows are used.
entries.where: all-time FV tab on CFB, CBB, hockey, soccer and tennis prospect pages

entries.short: Wins over a replacement starter in a 12-game season.
body: WAR = snap share x (line + weight x quality) x .227; 1 pt of margin a game = .0189 win% (928 FBS team seasons).
Line = margin lost when an average starter sits: QB 2.7, RB 1.7, EDGE 1.4, WR 1.35, CB 1.3, S 1.1, DT 1.0, LB 1.0.
Quality from Stat+, badges and FV. QB keeps 1.25 pts per SD; the rest goes to offensive teammates by snaps.
Replacement lineup wins .18 (2 of 12); an average team's starters total 3.8 WAR.
Team WAR (Nov 24 2026): starter time no graded player covers counts one SD below an average starter (season AV's line), not at
the WAR line. Held out by season 2019 to 2025, team WAR tracks SRS at R2 .654 against .639 (t 3.5, 7 of 7 seasons).
entries.where: CFB board, WAR leaders tab, team talent

entries.short: WAR minus snap share x line: wins over an average starter at the position.
body: Comparable across positions; below average < 0.

entries.short: WAR with quality from the stat-line parts that track winning.
body: CFB: PFN score plus position parts (QB cmp %, yds/att, INT rate; OL pressure rate; DT splash; CB yds/target).
Fit on 2024-25 team margin. Held out team r .88 vs .86 for WAR quality; win% r .73 vs .68.
NFL: same idea fit to team margin per game; on missed games t 4.9 vs 2.1 for AV WAR.
Next-season forecasts tie with WAR, so projections and game models stay on WAR.
NFL Nov 24 2026: weights fit per side, offense parts on points scored a game, defense parts on points allowed a game.
XV from weeks 1 to 9 on weeks 10 on margin, R2 .604 to .622 (t 2.19, 7 of 8 seasons); next season team R2 .235 to .258.
XV is the most descriptive NFL metric held out (.604 vs WAR .401, SV .257) and the most descriptive CFB one (.689 vs cWAR .639).
entries.where: CFB and NFL WAR leaders tabs (XV column)

entries.short: Wins over replacement: .6 x AV WAR + .4 x XV, season to date.
body: AV WAR = (AV - replacement AV at the sub-position x snap share) x .091 wins per AV.
.091 from team wins on team AV (160 team seasons 2021-25, r .86). Replacement team wins 3 of 17.
Defensive AV rebuilt from pressures, stops and plays on the ball. Two-way players earn WAR on each side.
entries.where: NFL WAR leaders, team WAR, rookies, standouts

entries.short: Production index: 100 + 25 x z of the position all-in-one score this season.
body: Source score: PFN QB+, RB+, WR+, TE+, OLi, EDGE+, DT+, LB+, CB+, SAF+; K and P by percentile.
z against the snap-weighted position mean, FBS or FCS. 125 = 1 SD above average.
FV production driver; validity vs NFL AV: TE .52, WR .50, QB .48, RB .48, EDGE .40, LB .40, DT .37.
entries.where: CFB board, WAR leaders, true freshmen

entries.short: xNIL = NIL market worth now; yNIL = estimated pay entering the season; zNIL = xNIL - yNIL.
body: xNIL = position price x on-field value (AV at FV, x playing time), shared within P4 and G5 pools.
yNIL = program budget split by a preseason index (P4 ~$20M, G5 ~$3M, FCS ~$0.4M a program).
Not fit to On3 valuations (they move only +18% per 10 FV). zNIL growth is 20% of each coach score.
FCS players at FBS-starter FV priced at 40% of the FBS rate. CBB xNIL: minutes share x (BPM + 3) at school price.
entries.where: CFB board, team talent, team builder, fv to xNIL charts; CBB recruits

entries.short: College on-field value a season: snap share x position weight x quality.
body: Quality = Stat+ z + .5 badge z + .25 FV z. Team R2 vs 2026 SRS .63 vs .44 for summed FV value.
Used for college injury cost and team value; NFL value stays on AV at FV.
entries.where: CFB team talent (Season AV), fv to war chart

entries.short: Cross Plus-Minus. NBA impact: .5 databallr DPM + .5 Basketball-Reference BPM, points per 100 possessions over average, as played.
body: The headline XPM on every NBA board. O-XPM and D-XPM are the same blend of each side.
Includes BPM's team adjustment: each team's players move by one amount per side so minutes-weighted O-XPM x 5 = ORtg - league, D-XPM x 5 = league - DRtg.
Same-season team net R2 0.999 (box blend before the adjustment 0.963, BPM 0.988); next season 0.647 (box blend 0.640, BPM 0.644).
The box blend before the adjustment feeds pXPM, the game models (which shrink it themselves) and the CBB board target. BPM only where no DPM row (*).
XPM and rookie boards default to qualified: 1,000 MP per 82 team games. Qualified rookies 2010-23: XPM orders next-three-season VORX .607 (VORX .604); all rookies .330.
entries.where: NBA VORX/XPM leaders, rookies, team pages, ARKLIST

entries.short: Projected XPM next season: XPM over three seasons by minutes, shrunk toward a role mean, aged. Depth charts and backup watch: toward replacement.
body: Boards: (k x role mean + MP x XPM + w1 x MP-1 x XPM-1 + w2 x MP-2 x XPM-2) / (k + MP + w1 MP-1 + w2 MP-2) + aging curve to next season.
k 200 MP, w1 0.35, w2 0.1; role mean = -3 + 1 ln(1 + MP82 / 100). Aging: next-season XPM change by age, fit on earlier seasons only.
Next-season XPM 2011-26, leave one season out: RMSE 1.187 vs 1.238 (one-dial k 600 shrink), 1.58 raw (t -7.28, 14/15 seasons).
Next-season team net rating, nine pairs, held out: R2 0.654; rXPM 0.640, BPM 0.644, DPM 0.623, k 600 shrink 0.619.
Depth chart and backup watch: XPM over three seasons (minutes weighted 1, .5, .25) x M / (M + 500) + replacement (-1.4) x 500 / (M + 500).
entries.where: NBA VORX/XPM leaders (pXPM chip), rookies, depth chart, backup watch

entries.short: Value Over Replacement XPM. NBA wins over replacement: .030 x (XPM + 1.4) x MP / 48.
body: Replacement XPM -1.4; both constants fit to team wins (480 team seasons 2011-26). Default sort of the XPM and rookie boards.
Team W% from minutes-weighted value, 2011-26: same season R2 0.938 on XPM vs 0.926 on the box blend before the team adjustment (t 2.33, 10/13 seasons); next season 0.679 vs 0.681 (t -0.25).
Rookies 2010-23, held out: VORX orders next-three-season VORX best (Spearman .398; pXPM .395, aXPM .379, XPM .330).
Next-three-season XPM: the rookie 3Y orders it best (.481; aXPM .413, XPM .417, VORX .351).
entries.where: NBA VORX/XPM leaders, projections, contract value

entries.short: MD: points per 100 matchup possessions a defender's assignments scored against everyone. PAOE: what they scored against him minus MD, shrunk by poss / (poss + 300).
body: Source rows: one defender on one offensive player in one game (NBA.com box score matchups via shufinskiy/nba_data)
partial possessions and points. Each assignment's season rate is pulled toward the league by 100 possessions.
Defenders with 1,000+ partial possessions. Odd/even game reliability of PAOE at 1,000+ possessions: r .82 (2017-18 to 2025-26).
As a prior-season team-defence input PAOE did not help (team net RMSE 3.528 vs 3.525, held 2023-26 t +0.13): display only.

entries.short: Projected XPM next season (given he plays) and over the next three (x the chance he plays in them).
body: From XPM (proj), age, projected minutes, a hinge above +3, and the two seasons before; coefficients by share of the season played.
Given he plays: fit on seasons with minutes, weighted by them. Held out 2012-23, 1,000+ minutes: 3Y RMSE 1.13, 1Y 1.14.
3Y = stay x XPM given he plays + (1 - stay) x -2. Stay = chance he plays in the next three seasons (XPM, age, minutes, games).
Held out 2012-23 (6,165 player seasons, 18% out of the league): RMSE 2.81 -> 2.78 (t -4.4, 11/12 seasons).
Display only.

entries.short: Season-to-date XPM blended with a preseason prior by minutes.
body: prior + (XPM - prior) x MP / (k + MP); k 509 veterans, 809 newcomers (7,269 player seasons 2012-26).
80% range covers .806 / .799 held out. Display only.

entries.short: Minimum salary + projected VORX x market $ per win, minus salary, every year left.
body: $ per win = payroll above the minimum / league projected VORX, refit on each update; +7% a year (assumption).
Player option counted only when it pays the player; team option only when it pays the team.

entries.short: The AAV a player would sign for as a free agent now: a share of the cap from position, age and last full season.
body: Fit on real signings, held out a signing year at a time against the mean by position x age. Forms pre-registered; live form = lowest held-out MAE whose top end is calibrated (priced 7%+ of the cap -> signed for 85-115% of it). Square root of the cap share, smeared back; clipped to the league minimum and maximum.

NHL: 3,241 CapWages deals 2010-26 (standard, 35+, two-way; no ELCs or extensions). WAR, pWAR, 3Y, points and TOI a game, games, age by F/D/G. MAE .83% of the cap vs 1.70 (t -40, 17/17 seasons; forward 11/11). Points and TOI alone tie it (t -1.4): the market pays for points.

NFL: 12,192 OverTheCap veteran contracts 2014-26 (3+ years after the draft). WAR last two seasons, snaps, games, age by position. MAE .86% vs 1.50 (t -52, 13/13; forward 9/9). WAR adds over snaps alone (t -18). Ceiling = record 24.5% (Burrow 2023).

NBA: 1,334 Basketball-Reference offseason signings 2011-26 (free agent, multi-year or plain contracts; next season salary on the signing team). XPM last two seasons, VORX, minutes, points and minutes a game, games, age, years in the league. MAE 2.60% vs 5.04 (t -19, 16/16; forward 11/11). XPM/VORX add over points and minutes alone (t -6, 14/16). Max 25/30/35% by years in the league; 2026-27 cap $165M (projected).
Soccer: not built. No public wage data reachable (Capology blocks); xMV is the transfer-market equivalent.
NHL against AFP Analytics' public projections, 109 signings of summer 2026 both priced (ours from a fit on earlier years only
AFP's dated May 18 2026): mean miss 1.03% of the cap vs AFP .77 (t +2.7 against ours)
restricted free agents 1.52 vs .85 (n 30), unrestricted .81 vs .70 (n 73). xAAV has no free-agent status input.
entries.where: NBA, NFL, NHL contract value tabs

entries.short: The contract length, in years, a player would sign for as a free agent now.
body: Same inputs and signings as xAAV (3,242 CapWages deals 2010-26), linear in years, clipped 1-8.
Held out a signing year at a time: mean miss .83 years vs 1.00 by position x age (t -13.0, 16/17 years)
Surplus = (xAAV - cap hit) x seasons left on the current deal.

entries.short: Projected Barttorvik BPM this season.
body: Ridge on last season, recruiting, age, size; in season blends to-date BPM.
Team context (Nov 3 2026): returning teammates' WAR, teammates' recruiting (top 8 -ln rank), WAA, transfer up/down.
Forward 2020-26 RMSE: returners 2.558 -> 2.462 (t 18), newcomers 3.439 -> 3.229 (t 14). Not an FV input.

entries.short: Wins over a replacement / average D-I player.
body: WAR = (sGBPM + 1.6) x minutes / 40 x 68 possessions a 40 / 100 x .0186 wins a point; WAA uses sGBPM.
GBPM = Barttorvik game BPM, the minutes weighted mean of his games' BPM. sGBPM = (GBPM x min + 100 x season mean) / (min + 100).
Replacement 1.6 below average = the 9th man's sGBPM (2025-26). Wins a point fit on 3,485 team seasons 2017-26:
wins = .38 x games + team WAR (r .87; season BPM gave .86). Season only: no earlier season enters a season's WAR.
Nov 24 2026: GBPM over season BPM, held out team win% R2 .633 to .658, 15 of 15 seasons; shrink: half B GBPM MSE 16.2 to 11.4
(10 of 10), held out team wins RMSE 3.348 to 3.331 (14 of 14). Season BPM stays the predictive input (next season .643 vs .612).
The textbook slope (.0347 at margin sd 11.5) overstates: schedules pair strong with strong and win odds flatten at the ends.
FV test: WAR, WAA, career and 5/4/3 WAR fail.
entries.where: CBB WAR leaders, stats, portal, returning

entries.short: BPM against the position: 100 + 25 x z.
body: z = (BPM - position mean) / position sd. Tabs: last season's norms (G -.23 / 3.84, F .57 / 4.13, C 1.71 / 4.56),
then this season's own once 40 players a position qualify. FV driver norms: G .10 / 3.85, F .50 / 4.05, C .52 / 4.31 (2008-16).
FV driver (Nov 3 2026): passes three fold rules (t 2.9-3.5, 4-5/5), held 2017-19 (+.17) and forward 2020-23 (+.26).
entries.where: CBB stats, WAR leaders, portal; FV inputs

entries.short: Hollinger single-game value.
body: PTS + .4 FGM - .7 FGA - .4 (FTA - FTM) + .7 ORB + .3 DRB + STL + .7 AST + .7 BLK - .4 PF - TOV.
FV and xBPM tests (a game, a 40, best game, 20+ games): all fail.

entries.short: 1st-2nd year players above their preseason projection.
body: xBPM up = live xBPM - preseason xBPM (minutes-blended). Also BPM over x, minutes, usage and FV gains.
Last season view: 2nd-years against their freshman line (WAR, BPM, minutes, usage gains).
FV tests: WAR gain, minutes gain, usage gain, BPM x (1 - minutes share) all fail (low-minute BPM passes the folds, not the top of the board).

entries.short: Team tables: last season's minutes and WAR back; roster grades.
body: Ret Min% = last season's minutes still on the roster (Barttorvik ids). In WAR = incoming transfers' WAR.
Talent = mean FV of the top 8. xNBA = sum of NBA%. TvE = talent rank - ARK rank.
FV tests: vacated minutes (opportunity), returning teammates' WAR, teammates' recruiting fail; the last two pass for xBPM.

entries.short: CBB FV target: mean of a career's best three NBA XPM seasons, each shrunk toward -2 by 500 minutes.
body: FV bands start at the XPM as many careers reached as reached the matching NBA role. See the CBB chart.

entries.short: Descriptive wins over replacement at goal value.
body: 5v5 on-ice xG vs teammates, PP xG /5, PK /4, finishing (goals - ixG), penalties, share of team leftover xG.
Goalies: GSAx at full credit. Sums to team goal differential (R2 .991).
Replacement = players outside each team's top 13 F / 7 D / 2 G.

entries.short: Projected WAR and projected goals per 60 over an average player.
body: HPM = Marcel-weighted (1 / .5 / .25) shrunk rates, components weighted by how well they carry to next season.
pWAR = (HPM - replacement) x TOI / 60 / goals per win. LOSO R2 .37 vs .26 before (t 4.24, 15/17 seasons).
Goalie GSAx barely repeats (weight .21), so goalie pWAR ~0.4 while goalie WAR runs ~7.
Nov 24 2026: 5 on 5 on ice and individual xG read MoneyPuck's flurry, score and venue adjusted columns; WAR keeps raw xG.
Next season team GD R2 .384 to .387 (t 2.88, 13 of 17 pairs); weights refit held out .373 to .376, walk forward t 3.59.
PP on ice xG at weight .2 fails (t 1.19 worse); score and venue alone is flat (t .32).
entries.where: NHL WAR leaders, backup watch, rookies; hockey prospect outcome (skaters)

entries.short: Goals saved above expected (MoneyPuck xG).

entries.short: Goals above replacement on one scale across leagues.
body: Shrunk per-90 rates (on-pitch xG for and against, on-off, npxG, xGBuildup, keeper saves) plus xG plus-minus (offence, defence)
weighted to next-season team goal difference.
On-pitch xG and xGBuildup are opponent and home adjusted: minus what that club allowed in its other matches, shrunk,
and the league's home / away gap. Odd vs even matches of a player-season, held 2022-26: on-pitch xG for r .65 to .70,
against .45 to .54, buildup .64 to .65. Own npxG and xA gain .003 to .006 and stay raw.
xG plus-minus: weighted ridge over 3 seasons of on-pitch spells (same 22 on the field)
a spell's npxG a 90 on the attacking side's players (offence) and the defending side's (defence), league-season and home terms
offence shrunk toward his xG + xA a 90 over the window, defence toward 0.
Replacement per position = regulars (900+ minutes) on the bottom three sides by goal difference of each finished league-season
pooled. League strength counts. Held out R2 .686 (.673 before plus-minus; nested test t -2.97, 9/11 seasons).
PAR = GAR x points per goal of difference (.626).
1Y P20/P80: held out projection residuals in five bands of season share; left out seasons hit .200 and .800 (3Y .201, .800).
aGAR/90 (first seasons) = GAR/90 less .0032 a year of age over 21. Ranks the next two seasons better than GAR/90: .664 vs .654, t -2.66.

entries.short: Team-share goals above replacement: minutes / 90 x (club rating - replacement) / 11.
body: Club rating = goals a match vs an average big-five club; replacement -2.5 (a bottom Scotland/Greece/Denmark side).
Outcome = mean of the best three tGAR seasons at ages 22-26. Differs from the senior GAR above (about 4-5x larger).

entries.short: Estimated market value in EUR millions with no market input.
body: Ridge on log Transfermarkt value: GAR now and past two seasons, minutes, age, position, league, club
national-team matchday squads in the last 12 and 24 months, last season's Champions League + Europa League minutes
last season's goals over xG and assists over xA.
Held out R2 .73 (Oct) to .80 (Jul). Gap to TM forecasts TM's next move (slope .26 Oct
12/12 seasons) and the summer fee over TM (corr .22, 1,850 sales 2015-22).

entries.short: Elo on every pro match since 1991 at every level; Elo+ against players the same age.
body: K = 250 / (matches + 5)^0.4, Slams x1.1, start 1500. Elo+ = 100 + 25 per SD vs same-age players with 20+ matches.

entries.short: Round win % a Counter-Strike player adds per round, opponent-adjusted; 0 = average tier-1 starter.
body: Box: team round share on its five per-round stat lines (kills, deaths, assists, ADR, KAST, openings, trades,
multi-kills, clutches, headshots, damage taken). Plus-minus: half the round share the box misses, split across the five.
No utility measure: bo3.gg has no flash or utility damage data; utility $ bought failed (t -2.5), accuracy hurt.
Tier lift: +0.5 x share of last year's rounds at S/A-tier events (low-tier pools link to the top through few maps).
Opponents credited x1.0, half-life 180 days, 25 rounds of shrink. Held out R2 .131 vs .120 Nov 2, .108 K-D.
Map offsets (Nov 24 2026): each player's decayed residual on each map, shrunk 1,000 rounds toward 0, added to RWA per map.
Held Jul 2025 to Oct 2026: next month map error .027816 to .027691, t by month 7.0, 15 of 16 months.

entries.short: xMV: prize money a player adds over replacement for two seasons; xTV: xMV priced on reported buyouts; team value sums the five.
body: xMV: prize money a player adds over a replacement-level player in a five of four average tier-1 starters, for two seasons
(aging curve, 15% a year discount). No fee data. xTV = A x xMV: what a buyout should cost. Team value = the current five's xTV summed.
Prize curve: a roster's prize money over the next 182 days on its five's mean RWA vs the tier-1 starter mean (VRS top 20),
Poisson, rating + rating squared, Valve's VRS prize ledger (every snapshot's top-ten winnings, Feb 2024 on).
Held out from Jul 2025: deviance explained 0.79 vs VRS points 0.76; both together 0.81 (rosters only, players can't carry VRS points).
A and the replacement level (tier-1 mean - q SDs) fit on 7 reported buyouts (insider/press, unconfirmed; group deals as the sum): A 1.49, q 4.
Leave one fee out: x1.60 typical miss; flat price per player x1.70; replacement fixed at the VRS 51-100 starters x2.33;
blend toward flat prices (A x xMV^g, g fit) x1.69: fails, kept linear.
Reported fees sit near flat and most are Falcons deals, so values are compressed and at that buyer's prices.
Eternal Fire to Aurora (reported under $2.5M for five) prices at $6.4M: a miss. Contracts are not public and not modelled.
Signed = the same value at the first map of the player's current stint (bo3.gg); stints from before Jul 2024 start there.
Transactions: moves read from map lineups (join, out, core, drop, rebrand, exit); loans and fees are not in the lineups.

entries.short: SV (season value) = this season's points a game over a replacement QB (-0.12 EPA a play), opponent-adjusted. Proj = the game model's QB term.
body: SV: each dropback and QB run less the defense's EPA allowed a play over the league's (its other games, shrunk with 300 plays); sum(aEPA + 0.12) / games with 10+ plays. Split-half r .512 raw, .528 adjusted (QB-seasons 250+ plays, 2021-26); wind, cold and rain added nothing.

Proj: weighted career EPA/play shrunk toward replacement with 100 pseudo-plays (fit), x the game model's QB coefficient. SV in the game model, as a swap or an extra term, failed held-out 2021-25 (margin MAE 10.010 -> 10.034 / 10.027).

entries.short: SV (season value) = this season's points a game over replacement. Skill: EPA a run / target. Defenders: credited EPA on plays with negative EPA.
body: Skill (RB, WR, TE): EPA less the defense's EPA allowed on that play type over the league's (other games, shrunk 300 plays) for RB and WR, less the play's weather for RB; replacement = the level of players past the starters (RB 48, WR 96, TE 48 by volume, 2016-25).

Defenders (DL, LB, DB): sack, INT, pass defensed, forced fumble, TFL, QB hit or a tackle on a failed play split -(EPA less the offense's rate over the league's; DL, DB); replacement = credit a snap past the starters (DL 128, LB 80, DB 160) x snaps.
Kept only where split-half r rose (P >= .9): opponent RB .199 -> .217, WR .172 -> .190, DL .308 -> .315, DB .147 -> .149; TE and LB stay raw. Weather only for RB (.217 -> .220).
In the game model's injury term in place of WAR a game it failed held out 2021-25 (MAE 10.010 -> 10.070, 0/5 seasons); WAR stays.

entries.short: SV (season value) = this season's points a game over replacement from EPA a play (QB: dropbacks + runs; skill: runs + targets), FBS games.
body: Opponent-adjusted for QB and RB (the defense's EPA allowed on that play type over the league's, other games, shrunk 300 plays): split-half r QB .360 -> .403, RB .179 -> .199; WR and TE stay raw (P .84 / .88 on 2025-26, when target ids are complete). Weather (Open-Meteo at the stadium) added nothing.
Replacement = players past the starters by volume in 2025 (QB 134, RB 268, WR 402, TE 134).
Defenders left out: public plays carry no tackles or snaps; splash credits had no split-half reliability.
Game model: the starter's adjusted season value scored the same as raw season EPA (t +0.5); the QB charge stays.
pSV/60: SV per 60 plays over three seasons weighted 1, .7, .5, shrunk to the QB mean with 650 plays.
Next season wMSE .0258 raw to .0159 (t -11.7, 10 of 10 seasons 2016-25).

entries.short: SVAR = SV points over replacement for the season, in wins. Shown next to WAR; the models keep WAR.
body: NFL: points / 36 a win (the game model's points a win). All-time seasons put on 17 games (1999-2020 x 17 / 16).
CFB: points / 53 a win (FBS win % rises .0189 a point of margin a game over 12 games, cfb_war_backtest college fit).

All-time SV history: NFL 1999 on (defenders 2013 on, snap counts); CFB 2014 on (cfbfastR play-by-play), CFB WR/TE and RB targets 2025 on (target ids); replacement moved with each season's league EPA a play (era).
Game model: every SV test failed against WAR (NFL QB MAE 10.010 -> 10.034; NFL non-QB injury term 0/5 seasons; CFB QB = raw), so WAR stays the model input.

entries.short: SV (season value) = this season's goals over replacement a 90 from this season alone; SVAR = SV x 90s, the season total in goals. Shown next to GAR; the models keep GAR.
body: GAR's weights on this season's inputs only: on-pitch xG for / against, on minus off, npxG, xGBuildup, and an xG plus-minus over this season's spells alone (GAR's spans three seasons). The xG part is scaled x0.943 so a side's players add up to its xG difference (R2 0.97).

Finishing (goals less npxG) and keepers' goals saved vs xG faced, shrunk toward the league average by min / (min + k): k 40,000 minutes for saves, 6,000 for finishing, from split-half reliability within a season (odd vs even matches: r 0.045 saves, 0.120 finishing; no player prior). A side's players then add up to its goal difference with R2 0.890 over 1170 team-seasons 2014-2026 (GAR on the same season 0.879).
Replacement = the xG part of bottom-three sides' regulars (GK -0.127, D -0.080, M -0.041, F -0.007 a 90), finishing and saves at league average. League strength x 0.058 a goal of club rating.
Weights fit on the same season (team goal difference, or first half to second half) could not split a side's xG between its players: team totals are the same either way, so GAR's split is kept.

entries.short: P(declares) x P(picked in the 2027 draft).
body: Declare: logit on ln xPick and age on draft day; ranked underclassmen ~94%, seniors ~69%, RS seniors 100%.
Picked: log-normal around the mock xPick; the SD narrows toward the draft (PFF dated boards, 2020-26).

entries.short: P(on another FBS or FCS roster next season).
body: Ridge logit on the 2024-25 and 2025-26 cycles: class, production, role, recruit rank, record, P(HC change), distance from home.
Out-of-time AUC .738. Transfer% + stay + exit = 100%. NIL-era data only (July 2021 on).

entries.short: Two terms for the miles from a player's hometown to each school: log distance and inside 150 miles.
body: Hometown from the recruiting history (ranked recruits: 27% of moves). No hometown on file: both terms are 0 for every school.
Fit 2022-24 moves, held 2025-26 moves with a hometown (n 371):
log loss of the chosen school 5.395 -> 5.244 (t 4.56 by origin team), top-10 hit 12.1% -> 21.8%. All moves: top-10 12.6% -> 15.1%.
A school within 150 miles of home: coefficient +.52; log miles -.35.

entries.short: P(on an FBS roster next season) for FCS players.
body: Logit on 2023-26 FCS-to-FBS moves: production, team strength, year in school, position. Capped at 1 - Draft%.

entries.short: P(on a D-I roster next season) for D-II and D-III players.
body: Ridge logit on NCAA D-II/III box scores, 2023-24 and 2024-25 move-ups: production, starts, minutes, team SRS, division.
Out of time on 2025-26 to 2026-27: AUC .899, log loss .077 vs .111 base rate.
FV = 20 + D-1% x V. V: his line translated to a first D-I season (shrunk BPM; ridge on 318 movers, out of time r .43/.60),
then what 2009-16 arrivals with that season and class became (Poisson index + monotone map, out-of-fold deviance t 2.8).

entries.short: Chance a college player leaves school for this NBA draft.
body: Recruit rank, minutes-shrunk BPM, class, era; plus the midseason board rank. Seniors and internationals 100%.

body: Rest of season = rate x exposure (minutes, TOI, snaps); rate = Marcel 1 / .7 / .5 with fitted shrink.
Recalibrated per season-left bin; checked by PIT on held-out seasons (+/- .03 overall).

entries.short: Chance of each award: a voter model on simulated rests of the season, blended with Polymarket where a liquid market is open.
body: Model: 3,000 simulated rests of the season, each finish scored by a voter model fit on past ballots.
Blend: model^.05 x market^.95, renormalised. 7 held 2025-26 races, winner log loss: model 2.32, market 1.12, blend 1.13 (t -2.3).
Blended only when the event has 3+ two-sided quotes, prices summing within 25% of 1 and $50,000 traded. Otherwise model only.
The cell hover keeps the model number; the weekly ledger scores the model alone against the market.
Conviction view: P(lead) = share of simulations in which he leads the award's pool on this season's value alone.
Games left run at this season's own rate: no last season, no shrunk or predictive rate, no voter model, no market.
NFL and CFB: SVAR by position (no SV: OL, K, P; CFB defence). NBA VORX, D-XPM for DPOY; NHL WAR, GSAx for Vezina; CBB BPM.
Soccer: SVAR (GAR rebuilt from this season alone: one-season xG plus-minus, finishing and keeper saves at face value).

entries.short: 3Y WAR = the chance he plays in the next three seasons x his WAR if he does.
body: Stay chance: logistic on pWAR pace, age, age squared, ln TOI per 82 and share of team games played.
WAR if he plays: the 3Y form refit on players who stayed.
Leave one season out 2010-23: skaters RMSE 2.455 -> 2.447 (t -6.9 by season, 14 of 14), goalies 4.074 -> 4.066 (t -3.0, 10 of 14).
Kept at every season share .1 to 1.
IN 3Y column (skaters): chance he plays in season S+3; held-out error under 3 points in every tenth.
Goalies fail that check (up to 10 points) and get no column.
NBA: 3Y XPM = stay x XPM given he plays + (1 - stay) x -2. Numbers under 1Y / 3Y XPM.

entries.short: Per-game points, rebounds, assists (NBA, CBB) and fantasy lines (NFL, CFB).
body: NBA walks the game model's minutes and P(play), plus pace, opponent, minutes freed by teammates out.
Held out 2024-26 PRA MAE 6.20 vs 6.46 for season average; CBB 5.42 vs 5.58.
NBA minutes in a team's first 10 games add preseason starts (share of the last two preseason games started
fading to 0 by game 11): games 1-10 held 2024-26 minutes MAE 4.714 -> 4.676 (t -3.48, 3/3 seasons).

body: Replacement = first non-starter: QB13, RB30, WR31, TE13, K13, DST13. Overall rank by VOR.

body: xWAR = WAR rate a snap before the week (three seasons shrunk to the group, updated in season) x snaps.

entries.short: 1st-2nd year QB/RB/WR/TE whose touches and targets are rising.
body: Lists usage growth; it is a watch list, not a model grade.

entries.short: P(first season at a quality bar next season), for players who have never reached it.
body: Bar = shrunk value near the 75-80th percentile of regulars; anyone already over it (career, this season included) is out.
NBA: BPM +1.0, 1,000+ MP. CBB: BPM +2.8, 40%+ min. NHL: WAR/1,000 min 1.19. Soccer: GAR/90 .090. NFL: PPR/G 12 (TE 9). CFB: PFN z .32.
Logistic on shrunk value + signals; each added alone, leave-one-season-out, t >= 2 and most seasons won, then Holm.
Pass: age or class curve everywhere; most sports: low-volume efficiency, projection gap. CBB adds team context (t 3.8).
Fail: vacated role (all six), coaching change, opportunity ahead, improvement trend, splines, Platt, boosted trees (never beat logistic).
Held-out t: NBA 7.9, CBB 14.4, NHL 5.6, soccer 6.2, CFB 6.0, NFL 3.3.

entries.short: Projected output at a bigger workload, from players whose workload changed.
body: Workload: USG (NBA, CBB), TOI split EV/PP (NHL), shot involvement SI% (soccer), target/touch share (NFL).
Next-season efficiency on this season shrunk for sample + workload change x context blocks, ridge, held out by season.
Workload change alone: no efficiency drop on average (selection: players earn the work).
NBA: shot profile sets the slope (high-2P% finishers lose most); CBB: shot profile, role, frame, level, low-usage rates.
NHL: EV P/60 rises with minutes (instrumented 0.14 a minute). Soccer: role. NFL RB: -0.23 Y/OPP per 10 share points.
Tiers past the 99th percentile of observed jumps are beyond the data. CFB: no tiers, every test failed.
CEIL: 80th percentile season one tier up (NBA/CBB usage +5, NHL TOI +3, soccer SI% +10), role seasons; mean + q x spread.
CEIL scales: NBA XPM, CBB BPM, NHL shrunk WAR/1k, soccer shrunk GAR/90. Workload change x context passes in all four.
CEIL held-out t (pinball .80): NBA 3.9, CBB 6.1, NHL 6.0, soccer 9.3; coverage 79-80% of workload-up seasons.

entries.short: Second and third-string players graded above a starter.
body: Gap = backup value - starter value (FV in college; WAR, pXPM, HPM or GAR in the pros). College listed at gap >= 3.
Rank by xGap = the gap projected over two seasons, adding the age (or class) gap; held out t -3.0 to -15.6.

body: CFB: nearest 2014-22 profiles. Hockey stage 3-4 comps also feed FV (held-out pass); elsewhere display only.

entries.short: G League player's chance of NBA minutes next season, of 500+ NBA minutes (per 82 games), and expected NBA VORX over the next 3 seasons.
body: Ridge logistic (L2 1) on 8,036 G League seasons 2008-25, regular season + Showcase Cup, 50+ minutes; Showcase-only seasons 2022-25 pooled in with a part-season flag.

Inputs: age, age^2, log minutes, games, per-36 box (pts reb ast stl blk tov 3PA FTA, Game Score, +/-), TS%, usage, AST%, OREB%, DREB%, net rating, PIE; NBA minutes and XPM (shrunk to -2 with 500 MP) through last season; draft round, log pick, years since the draft.
xVORX = P(any NBA game in 3 seasons) x ridge E[3-season VORX | plays].

Leave one season out vs the same model without G League stats: NBA% log loss .338 vs .378 (t -6.2, 16/18 seasons), AUC .883 vs .846 (no NBA minutes yet: .912 vs .872); 500% .191 vs .207 (t -4.3), AUC .897 vs .862; xVORX RMSE .921 vs .981 (t -3.1). All pass Holm.
Calibrated by decile held out (top NBA% decile .87 predicted, .86 observed). Base rates 23% / 8%.
Two-way to standard contract not modelled: no contract-type history.
xXPM = ridge E[NBA XPM over his NBA minutes, next 3 seasons | plays], weighted by those minutes (lambda 300).
xVORX counts 0 for a season out of the NBA (75% of G League seasons): it sits near 0 for most; xXPM is the rate alone.
xXPM held out vs no G League stats: minute-weighted RMSE 1.44 vs 1.60 (t -3.6, 11/15 seasons, Holm), bias .01.

body: SV a 90 at weights 1, .5, .25, shrunk toward the position mean of regulars by 225 minutes (defenders 450, keepers 28,800),
less .008 a year over age 29. Nov 24 2026, held out: next season team GD R2 .634 to .650, 11 of 11 pairs;
r with next season's SV a 90 .690 to .718. The most predictive soccer metric on players; display only.

entries.term: Most predictive and most descriptive metric (by sport)
entries.short: Each sport's metrics scored on one test (Nov 24 2026, held out, no 2026-27 outcomes).
body: Describe: season value x season minutes summed per team, on that season's results, held out. Predict: season n value x
season n+1 minutes, on n+1 results; and a player's value against his next season. Tennis and CS2: held out matches and maps.
NBA: describe rXPM (.999), predict pXPM (.657). NFL: describe XV (.604), predict pXP/60 within position, AV for teams (.317).
CFB: describe XV (.689), predict cWAR (.256, tie XV). CBB: describe WAR on GBPM (.658), predict the roster prior BPM (.783).
NHL: describe WAR (.978), predict pWAR for teams (.387), Marcel WAR for a player (r .446). Soccer: describe SVAR (.894),
predict p/90 (.650, r .718). Tennis: describe PA (.141), predict ARK (.107, tie Elo). CS2: describe season RWA, predict RWA rating
(next month team R2 .124, player r .820), ARK for teams. Public metrics scored: nflverse EPA, PFN impact, Barttorvik PRPG,
MoneyPuck game score, FotMob rating, Transfermarkt value, official tennis rank, HLTV 2.0 style rating, bo3.gg rating: none leads.

entries.short: Chance an uncommitted recruit signs with each school in his recruitment list; the top school is shown in the Team cell.
body: Conditional logit over his ESPN recruitment list (3+ schools), fit walk-forward by class, recency weight .75 a class (CFB).
Terms: program pull and tier, grade x tier, hometown distance, home state, conversion rate (signed / listed), on-field Elo (CFB).

CFB also: On3/Rivals visits (official, unofficial count, latest, last 90 days) and the confidence-weighted share of On3 expert picks. Trained as of 30 days before each commitment; live uses everything to date.

entries.short: Best team-seasons (overall, offense, defense) and best player seasons and careers in each sport, each season measured against its own league. One sport at a time: no cross-sport scale.
body: Rtg+ / Off+ / Def+ = 100 + 25 z (the Stat+ scale): z = (rating - that season's league mean) / s, s = the upper semi-deviation x sqrt 2, sqrt(2 x mean of max(rating - mean, 0)^2), pooled over the season and the two either side (Nov 23 2026; was the SD). s equals the SD in a symmetric season but is not stretched by a long bottom tail: a 0-points-allowed floor in low-scoring eras, blowout losers, a wide spread of weak programs. 100 = an average team that season; 125 = one s better; 175 = three.

Why z and not raw points: scoring levels and the spread between the best and worst teams change by era (fewer, deeper leagues; 1900s college blowouts; dead-ball hockey). Dominance over the league you played in is the comparable quantity; the raw rating is shown beside it.

Team ratings: CFB ridge SRS on every major-college game (margin capped at 35, home edge, offense / defense the same ridge on capped points; jhowell.net scores 1900-2025); NFL the same ridge on every NFL, AFL and AAFC game including playoffs (FiveThirtyEight scores to 1998, nflverse from 1999; 1920-2025); CBB Sports Reference SRS / OSRS / DSRS (1950-2026); NBA Basketball Reference SRS, ORtg and DRtg against the league average (1947-2026; off / def from 1951-52); NHL Hockey Reference SRS, goals for / against a game against the league + half the SOS (1918-2026, no 2004-05); soccer big-five clubs, goals a match vs the big-five average at season end (2005-2026); CS2 best Valve VRS points in a calendar year, each snapshot's top 50 as the league (2024-2026).
Lists: the top 250 plus the top 25 of every decade, so the Era filter shows each decade's best. CH = champion (CFB national title share, NFL league / Super Bowl winner).

Era check: share of the top 100 by decade against the decade's share of all rows, KL divergence (0 = every decade represented by its size), era-adjusted vs raw, and the line = the 95th percentile of the KL when the top 100 are drawn era-blind (4,000 multinomial draws on the decade shares); pass = adjusted under the line. Player lists count each player's best season once (one player's run, such as Gretzky's eight 1980s seasons, is not an era); hockey prospects are binned by draft class (5 years). Teams: CFB 0.042 vs 0.319 (line 0.107); CFB 0.030 vs 0.099 (line 0.107) offense; CFB 0.090 vs 0.554 (line 0.107) defense; NFL 0.019 vs 0.209 (line 0.093); NFL 0.025 vs 0.078 (line 0.093) offense; NFL 0.024 vs 0.206 (line 0.093) defense; CBB 0.042 vs 0.115 (line 0.070); CBB 0.017 vs 0.183 (line 0.070) offense; CBB 0.038 vs 0.104 (line 0.070) defense; NBA 0.023 vs 0.022 (line 0.078); NBA 0.008 vs 0.090 (line 0.071) offense; NBA 0.014 vs 0.066 (line 0.071) defense; NHL 0.024 vs 0.384 (line 0.100); NHL 0.030 vs 0.221 (line 0.100) offense; NHL 0.041 vs 0.294 (line 0.100) defense; soccer 0.002 vs 0.078 (line 0.029); soccer 0.002 vs 0.142 (line 0.029) offense; soccer 0.023 vs 0.056 (line 0.029) defense; CS2 0.000 vs 0.000.

Players: peak seasons = every player-season ranked on its own (one player can hold several rows), career = sum of seasons, each season valued over replacement in its own league and scaled to a full season where seasons were short.

NBA: VORX per 82 games (XPM: DPM + BPM blend from 2009-10, BPM before); before 1973-74 BPM is estimated from WS/48 and PER (fit on 1974-85 players with 500+ minutes, r 0.90; tagged est); minutes start 1951-52. NHL: point shares per 82 games (Hockey Reference; skaters OPS + DPS, goalies GPS). CBB: the site's CBB WAR on every Barttorvik season from 2007-08. NFL: peak = the site's AV WAR (rebuilt AV, no special teams) from 2012 (snap counts); career = Pro Football Reference weighted career AV (nflverse draft_picks; drafted players 1980 on). Soccer: the site's GAR, big-five seasons from 2014-15.

Tennis: Elo on every tour-level singles match 1968 on (Sackmann archive; K = 250 / (matches + 5)^0.4, Slams x 1.1). Elo+ = 100 + 25 x (peak Elo that year - the year's #20 year-end Elo) / SD of the year's top 100; peak counts after 40 career matches. Career = sum over years (20+ matches) of the year-end Elo over the #20 line in those SDs.

Era adjustment (rate + volume, Nov 20 2026): a season's rate is set against that season's regulars, rate' = mean_ref + SD_ref x (rate - season mean) / season SD (SD pooled over the season and two either side), and its volume against that season's load, vol' = vol x q_ref / q_season (q = 90th percentile of the regulars' volume); the sport's own value formula then runs on rate' and vol'. _ref = the mean over the last 10 seasons, so values read in today's units. Unadj = as played.

Per sport. NBA: rate XPM, volume minutes per 82 team games, VORX = .030 x (XPM' + 1.4) x min' / 48 (BPM is per 100 possessions, so pace and the 3-point era are in the rate; the volume term takes out 45-minute 1960s loads). NHL: WAR per 82 against the season, skaters and goalies apart (no ice time before 2008-09, so no volume term). CBB: rate BPM (regulars 400+ min), volume minutes (short 2020-21 season scaled up). Soccer: rate GAR per 90 (regulars 900+ min), volume minutes. CS2: calendar years 2024 on, rate RWA over that year's replacement (median of 1,000+ round players; opponents at their year-end ratings), volume rounds (current year to date scaled to a full year), RAR = RWA' x rounds' / 100. Hockey prospects: drafted skaters' seasons outside the NHL (20+ games, ages 16-21), NHLe+ = 100 + 25 z of log(NHLe + 5) against drafted skaters of the same age and position that season. Tennis: Elo against the year's #20 in SDs of the year's top 100 is already a rate against the season; no volume term (peak Elo).

NFL WAR seasons (Nov 23 2026): rosters grew (1,734 WAR rows in 2013, 2,055 in 2021) and the top thinned, so each season's WAR is set against that season's starters at the position (the top k by WAR, k = the position's share of rows x 704 = 32 teams x 22 starters) in the last 10 seasons' units. CFB QB and RB / WR / TE Yds+: the over-average value is multiplied by the last 10 seasons' SD over the season's SD (pooled over the season and two either side; QBs: TAY/P of qualified passers, skill: AY of the season's starters at the position).

entries.short: Head coaches ranked by Score, in wins: value over what the program does with other coaches, plus titles weighted the way the Halls of Fame weigh them.
body: WAx: each season, wins over the program's expectation on a standard season (CFB 12 games, CBB 30): G x [Phi(r/s) - Phi(e/s)], s = the decade's points-to-wins probit scale.
Expectation e: the program's other coaches' seasons within 15 years (weight exp(-gap/6), the 2 seasons after he leaves skipped), shrunk 1 season toward the conference that year.
Ratings: CFB ridge SRS from every major-college game since 1900; CBB Sports Reference SRS from 1950, 1939-49 estimated from win% and conference.
cWAR = WAx + 1.23 (CFB) / 2.41 (CBB) a season: replacement level = the mean season of coaches with two or fewer seasons.

NT / CT: national and conference title shares, ties split. CFB national: AP from 1936, AP + Coaches Poll halves from 1950, share of major-selector picks before 1936. CFB conference: title game, else best conference record. CBB: NCAA title; regular-season conference title.
Title difficulty: log2(1 + sum exp(z/t)) over the field (z = season rating z-score, t = 0.25 fit on who won), over its mean.

Score = cWAR + 52 a national title + 8.5 a conference title (CFB); 108 + 31.5 (CBB). Weights: logistic fit of Hall of Fame selection on cWAR, NT, CT (done by 2019, 8+ seasons; 136/443 CFB, 71/787 CBB), title coefficient / cWAR coefficient.

Coord (CFB): OC/DC unit points over the program's unit expectation, 1990-2025, in wins (column). In Score x 0.06 = slope of later head-coach WAx rate on coordinator rate (n 121, t 0.46; OC r 0.09, DC r -0.07): coordinator results barely carry. CBB: no assistant history.
Hall of Fame AUC: Score 0.89 vs raw wins 0.90 (CFB); 0.88 vs 0.83 (CBB).
Movers (old-job WAx rate vs new job, 3+ seasons each): CFB r 0.14 (n 373, t 2.69); CBB r 0.20 (n 754, t 5.51).
Walk-forward from 2010: shrunk WAx predicts the next 10 seasons' WAx at r 0.19 CFB / 0.37 CBB (win% 0.19 / 0.12); Score per season predicts next-10 title equity at r 0.40 / 0.60 (win% 0.09 / 0.43).
Stability: top-100 rank correlation across expectation settings (decay 3-12, shrink 1-3, no skip) 0.97+ CFB, 0.98+ CBB; odd/even-season WAx split-half 0.75 / 0.82.

NBA / NHL: the same method on Sports Reference SRS (NBA points, NHL goals), an 82-game season, the franchise as the program (one id through relocations), league title = national title, a place in the Finals / Stanley Cup Final = conference title; a coach replaced in season gets his share of the games. Seasons with an SRS on file: 1947-2026 / 1922-2026.

NBA / NHL replacement level 8.61 / 5.04 wins a season; Score = cWAR + 166 / 39 a title + 0.0 / 3.2 a Finals appearance. Hall of Fame label: NBA the Naismith Coach category (17/45); NHL the Hockey Hall of Fame Builder category (11/29; that Hall has no coach class, and coaches inducted as players are left out of the fit).

NBA / NHL tests: Hall of Fame AUC Score 0.96 / 0.89 vs raw wins 0.85 / 0.66; movers r 0.17 (n 100, t 1.75) / 0.15 (n 89, t 1.4); walk-forward from 2010: shrunk WAx to next-10 WAx r -0.07 / -0.14 (win% 0.03 / -0.11), Score per season to next-10 title equity r 0.52 / -0.12 (win% 0.36 / 0.02); split-half 0.74 / 0.86.

NFL: the same method on the all-time teams' ridge points a game (NFL, AFL and AAFC, 1920-2025), a 17-game season, the franchise as the program (one id through relocations); head coaches and their own records from pro-football-history.com, an in-season change split by games. League title = national title; a title-game season (conference championship, the league title game before the merger) = conference title.

NFL replacement level 2.12 wins a season; Score = cWAR + 0 a title + 194.4 a title-game season (Pro Football Hall of Fame coaches 21/65; coaches inducted as players are left out of the fit). Coordinator seasons carry nothing into head-coaching WAx (slope .01, t .07, 94 coaches), so there is no coordinator term.

NFL tests: Hall of Fame AUC Score 0.88 vs raw wins 0.78; movers r 0.25 (n 75, t 2.21); walk-forward from 2010: shrunk WAx to next-10 WAx r 0.41 (win% 0.25), Score per season to next-10 title equity r 0.39 (win% 0.27); split-half 0.71.

Era check (Nov 23 2026): mid-career decades of the top 100 by Score vs every ranked coach's coached seasons by decade (a career total grows with seasons), KL, and the era-blind 95% line (top 100 drawn at random); per-season Score rate vs coaches by decade: CFB 0.066 (line 0.108), rate 0.086 (line 0.108); CBB 0.077 (line 0.077), rate 0.037 (line 0.078); NBA 0.030 (line 0.075), rate 0.019 (line 0.077); NHL 0.023 (line 0.094), rate 0.019 (line 0.095); NFL 0.009 (line 0.095), rate 0.013 (line 0.093).
